content: If gateway support is enabled via J1939NmGatewaySupport, and the configuration contains a J1939NmSharedAddressSpace, the J1939Nm shall transmit all AddressClaimed messages received on one of the channels referenced by J1939NmSharedAddressSpace on all other channels referenced by the same J1939NmSharedAddressSpace.
